name: Little Lamb
source:
Evangeline is a college student who knows next to nothing about love. But when she meets her idol, Miles Thornborough, she finds there's a lot more dangers to look out for than she ever could've imagined.

[From [url=https://glass-quantum.itch.io/little-lamb]Itch.io[/url]]
